name: The Donald Trump Dating Simulator from Hell
source:
Have you ever wanted to date a balding billionaire future president? No? Well, here's your chance to do it anyway! You are Nicole News, and it is your job to conduct an interview with The Donald. Will you be FIRED or find love? There are 2 different endings to be found, love with The Donald or...you'll find out!

[From [url=https://simsoftgames.itch.io/the-donald-trump-dating-simulator-from-hell] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否曾想和一名秃顶的亿万富翁、未来的总统约会？没有？那也没关系，现在你有机会了！你是妮可·纽斯，工作是采访“唐纳德”。你会被解雇，还是找到爱情？游戏有两个不同结局：与“唐纳德”相爱，或者……玩下去就知道了！

（来源：[url=https://simsoftgames.itch.io/the-donald-trump-dating-simulator-from-hell]itch.io[/url]）
